caseTitle: detail: metadata, ruled sections, refusals, restart and favorite

observations.text: Two disposable namespaced users. The viewer owns a logged completed record, an unlogged completed record and a never-started record; the other user owns one completed record.

Session Detail: one Overview card holds the facts (dl), provenance and the Mood/Notes sub-groups, each with a ruled heading; each section is one card whose later blocks are separated by an internal rule; the outline never skips a level.
A section heading is a disclosure button: Enter toggles aria-expanded, and the focused trigger is bracketed.
Another user’s completed record and a random id both answer Workout not found with no sections disclosed; Open history returns to /history.
Back on a directly entered record goes to /history; Back on a record opened from History returns to the prior in-app route.

dispositions.reason: Restart with an active session raises the shared workout-chrome confirmation, whose after evidence belongs to the workout lifecycle group.
